title: Holding the Dirty Thing by the Clean Side

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: Decentralized brands provide one proposed experiment in a different distribution of authority.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: A shared name can carry recognizable standards across independent people and organizations.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: Its custodians need enough power to protect the promise associated with that name.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: They should not thereby own every participant’s identity or future possibilities.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: The chapter examines membership, disagreement, contribution, and the practical dignity of departure.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: It also recognizes that a shared bridge can become another toll gate.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: The proposal is not presented as a universal replacement for other institutions.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: Its reading value lies in testing whether cooperation can preserve credible independence.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: Some burdens arise from real limits that cannot disappear through a better explanation.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: Care, attention, time, housing, and ecological capacity can remain scarce despite technical progress.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: The book also examines status competition, dominance, and the fear of losing position.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: These pressures make institutional repair harder than a simple appeal to good intentions.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: They do not settle who should bear a particular sacrifice.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: Naming a limit must remain separate from declaring its present distribution unavoidable.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: The argument asks for explicit choices, compensation, review, and protection against permanent subordination.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: Its ambition is a more honest institutional grammar, rather than a world without conflict.
